title: SubmissionAcknowledgedPayload
description: Payload of the SubmissionAcknowledged event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml, INV-NOTE-3 §19.8; class: domain). Authored by INV-T-2854 (T10). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required. The optional members entityRef and direction name the entity and the direction of the acknowledged document.

entityRef.description: The entity of the acknowledged version; the publisher always sets it and a consumer treats an event without it as a contract violation.

direction.description: The direction of the acknowledged document; the publisher always sets it and a consumer treats an event without it, or with any other value, as a contract violation.
